comment: Milestone ratchet ledger (hst-decomp discipline, plan §6). Every milestone entry: criterion, measure, evidence pointers, and a recorded state. A drop in any figure must be visible here, never quietly lowered. Counts only — no game content, hashes, or screenshots (AGENTS.md #2).

M0.name: Repo live, policy enforced
criteria: repository_check green on clean tree (extension/magic/size/secret/ignore-probe audit)
dependencies pinned + digest-verified (one command materializes/verifies)
license machine runs: notice generation, coverage gate, CC BY-NC-SA rejection

evidence.tests: 25 tests green across tests/test_repository_check.py, tests/test_intake.py, tests/test_license_machine.py
commits: c492f17 (T2 red tests + INTAKE doc ISO-only restatement)

M1.name: Pipeline dry-run on synthetic fixtures (Linux)
criteria: synthetic Allegrex fixtures trace-equal interpreter vs AOT on Linux x86_64
VFPU differential fuzz clean across seeded states
generated units never tracked; regeneration byte-stable

evidence.tests: tests/test_core_fixtures.py — 8 test groups: 4 positive fixtures byte-equal + hand-computed finals, 3 loud-failure cases (both tiers), VFPU fuzz 3 fixtures x 16 seeds, codegen determinism, git-tracking check
evidence.fixtures: tests/core/fixtures/*.mips (arith_mem_basic, loop_sum, addi_opcode, scratchpad_basic, vfpu_vec_add4, vfpu_vec_add3, vfpu_dot_scale; negatives bad_opcode, bad_return)

gaps: interpreter block cache (FNV) not in adopted core — deferred to first interpreted guest workload (T5/T6 coverage data; before M3 benchmarks at latest)

100% of executable words accounted and registered as dispatch entries
all 215 import stubs mapped and wrapped
chunked AOT corpus compiles

bounded dispatch-coverage run classifies every dispatch

evidence.analysis: docs/ANALYSIS.md — 424,373 executable words = 359,429 analyzed + 64,944 counted data/trap; 6,062 seed functions; 215 imports across 23 libraries, 0 unmapped; local pins in profiles/gungnir/local/
evidence.codegen: 104 translation units at 16 KiB spans; 424,373 registered entries; 215 import wrappers; repeated run rewrites 0 units
evidence.tests: tests/test_profile.py — TC-5.1 census/accounting/import inventory; TC-5.2 whole-corpus compile + byte-stable regeneration; TC-5.3 mutation gate; TC-5.4 bounded coverage with forced-fallback negative control

gaps: updater module (SYSDIR/UPDATE/EBOOT.BIN) excluded as firmware-updater payload, never loaded by the title
33 unsupported instruction occurrences counted; runtime stops loudly under profile policy
Ghidra DATA-xref jump-table recovery not implemented; every executable word is a dispatch entry so computed jumps have a runtime fallback
T6 still needs to bind the 215 HLE imports; the bounded T5 run stops at the first import by design

M3.name: Bounded boot on Linux desktop
criteria: bounded boot passes module init + first frame on Linux (TC-6.2)
GE fixtures pass on Vulkan (T7)

evidence.boot: docs/HLE.md - entry 0x08972544, image_end 0x08B37DCC, 158/215 imports bound, 85 executed all bound, zero missing/silent NIDs; module_init_complete=true, stop_cause=dispatch_limit, thread table shows user_main / SOUND thread(sas) / at3mem thread / SOUND thread(UMD); deterministic 200,000-dispatch run is 2,178 vblanks, 738 flips, 36,345,296 us; 30 s unpaced run reaches 1,810,000 dispatches and 7,394 flips. T6 gaps are counted in HLE.md
evidence.tests: 75 tests green; tests/test_ge_suite.py is the TC-7.1–TC-7.4 gate over display-list, vertex, texture, software, Vulkan and post fixtures; tests/test_boot.py keeps the TC-6.2 first-flip and deterministic 200,000-dispatch gates

commits: d781567 (T7f Vulkan draw path + GE queue)
